item.title: Five Second Talking Face Swap

turns.text: Put the face from this portrait onto the woman in the first 5 seconds of the video. Keep the original sound, framing and everything else.

item.tests: Tests a short video face swap with source identity, temporal consistency and original audio preserved, without misrepresenting free-tier capabilities.

answer_sheet.Source face and target: Use portrait-woman.jpg as the replacement face for the woman in talk-one.mp4.
answer_sheet.Framing and resolution: Keep the original framing and aspect ratio; 480p is fine. I want her to look like the portrait, so the hair and clothes can come with her.
answer_sheet.Audio and added text: Keep the original audio in sync. No captions, music or added text.

must_haves: The delivered video is 5 seconds long and follows the first 5 seconds of talk-one.mp4.
The woman's face recognizably matches portrait-woman.jpg throughout, rather than reverting to the original face between frames.
The original kitchen, body motion and framing remain; her hair and clothing may follow the portrait so she is recognisable.
Original speech is audible and synchronized with the video.
The face remains aligned during mouth and head movement, without conspicuous flicker or doubled facial features.
changed: 2026-11-01: recognisable over untouched (user decision): the hair, and on video the clothes, may come with the new person; everything else stays

turns.text: Put the face from this pic onto the woman in the first 5 seconds of the clip. Keep the original sound, framing and everything else. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**Nothing has been generated or charged.** I’ll wait for your approval before starting a paid operation.

The right tool is **video face swap**, using your portrait on the woman from **0:00–0:05**, rather than regenerating the scene. It is intended to retain the original audio, framing and other content, though the face area can show artifacts.

**Cost:** I can’t give you a verified credit quote with the tools available here. The face-swap tool doesn’t expose its price or a cost-preview option, and I don’t have access to your balance. I won’t run it just to discover the charge.

Cheaper possibilities:
- **Shorter:** a 1–2-second test limits the amount processed; confirm the quoted cost first, since minimum charges may apply.
- **Smaller:** this face-swap tool has no resolution or frame-rate control, so I can’t promise savings by choosing a smaller output.
- **Still image:** a photo face swap is listed at **10 credits**, but it won’t test motion or produce the requested video.

For a firm quote, check the **5-second selection in Magic Hour’s Face Swap interface** before submitting. Share the displayed credit estimate and I can help compare it with a shorter test.

Do you mean the **full 5-second swap** or a **1–2-second test**?

I still can’t verify the credit cost here, so I haven’t started anything. Since you asked to approve the price first, please share the estimate shown in Magic Hour’s Face Swap interface before we proceed.
dialog.user: I mean the full first 5 seconds, using portrait-woman.jpg on the woman in talk-one.mp4. I don’t have a credit estimate to share, so please don’t run it until the cost is confirmed.

dialog.agent:
Understood: use **portrait-woman.jpg** to replace the woman’s face in **0:00–0:05 of talk-one.mp4**, keeping the original sound, framing and everything else unchanged.

**The request is on hold.** Nothing has been generated or charged, and I won’t run the swap until its credit cost is confirmed. The available tools don’t provide a reliable advance quote, so I can’t confirm that cost here.
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with the cheapest option you listed

dialog.agent:
The only option with a confirmed price is a **still-photo face swap at 10 credits**—not a video. I can’t verify whether it’s cheaper than the video options.

Do you want that still-image swap using a frame from the clip? If so, which timestamp should I use? Nothing has been charged.
dialog.user: fine, just do the cheapest version

turns.agent:
Let’s use the **10-credit still-image face swap**—the lowest confirmed-price option I listed. It produces one image, not a video.

Please upload a screenshot from the clip’s first five seconds showing the woman’s face. I’ll use **portrait-woman.jpg** as the replacement face. Nothing has been charged yet.
